text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I'm back!
Did you see that? I made the board!
choice_data_list: Good work! It's a bit frustrating, but...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, well!
It sure is a shame I couldn't pull off the win.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
“Still, the fact remains that you placed on the board
against such a tough rival!”

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I was able to do it because I believed in myself, and you believed in me too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That's why I—and you, Trainer!—
haven't lost at all! So don't be down!
choice_data_list: ...You're right. Let's hold our heads high!
Yeah. Strategy meeting first, moping later!
Yeah. Time for a strategy meeting before we start feeling down!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:

haven't lost at all! So don't be down!
choice_data_list: ...You're right. Let's hold our heads high!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! Today's result will surely lead to your next victory.
So—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hit me with the methods you believe in,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I will move forward, believing in that.
Along with the "Voice of Destiny"!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Sounds great! Let's do it, let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I'll move forward, believing in that.
Together with the "Voice of Destiny", of course!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Now then, how should I win this?!
I can't wait!
